prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual full-body transparent 2D fighting-game action sprite of ABSTRACTING JAX. Reference 1 is the approved strict design lock for silhouette, proportions, exact transformation patches, eyes, colours and polished cel shading. Reference 2 supplies official design details only; do not imitate its squat toy proportions, setting or lighting. Tall lanky purple cartoon rabbit, two very long ears, long thin limbs, pink overalls/yellow buttons. One normal yellow eye with black rectangular pupil, one yellow glove and broad purple foot. Opposing head half, very long ear, arm and leg are angular dark crystal with concentric pastel eyes. Keep exactly the approved anatomical side of every transformation and all normal body sections; not fully abstracted or chibi. Create a genuinely distinct natural action pose, not a mirrored/cropped selection image. Every limb, crown/hat/ear tip, attached mask and crystal spike must fit fully inside clear transparent margins on ALL sides. One connected character, crisp detailed 2D art on true transparent RGBA; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, glow, particles, labels, watermark, inset or duplicate. POSE: CROUCH defense facing screen RIGHT: bend both knees deeply and lower the hips, torso leaning forward, both hands held compactly near face/chest, both feet remain planted and separated. Keep all details within canvas.
COSTUME LOCK: the pink overalls have EXACTLY TWO round yellow buttons TOTAL, one fastening each shoulder strap at the upper bib/chest, just like reference 1. No additional waist buttons, no duplicate button row, no yellow button at the pocket. Keep one plain square bib pocket and all normal/crystal anatomy on its approved side.

portableReferences.restoreInstruction: The exact reference is archived in this repository. If unavailable, download the named official image URL, verify and visually inspect it before generation. For an expired storyboard URL, refresh the storyboard through the official episode player metadata.

observations: Deep defensive crouch facing screen right with both knees bent, feet separated and planted, torso forward and both fists guarding the face. Approved normal/crystal anatomy remains on its original sides. Corrected overalls contain exactly two yellow strap buttons and one bib pocket. Both long ears, hands, crystal tips and full feet remain inside the canvas.
Native RGBA and clear threshold-12 contour margins verified; source bytes unchanged.
visualReview.scope: Approved reference identity and sprite technical fit; not canonical episode certification.
